title: Human body: skin, muscles, skeleton and organs

parts.label: Skin
parts.info: The body's largest organ: a waterproof, protective barrier that also senses and helps control temperature.

parts.label: Skeletal muscles
parts.info: About 600 muscles that move the skeleton by contracting.

parts.label: Skeleton
parts.info: Bones and cartilage that support, protect organs and make blood cells.

parts.label: Brain
parts.info: Controls the body and processes information.

parts.label: Heart
parts.info: Muscular pump that drives blood around the body.

parts.label: Major blood vessels
parts.info: Arteries and veins that carry blood to and from the heart.

parts.label: Lungs
parts.info: Site of gas exchange between air and blood.

parts.label: Liver
parts.info: Processes nutrients, makes bile and detoxifies the blood.

parts.label: Stomach
parts.info: Stores food and starts protein digestion with acid and pepsin.

parts.label: Small intestine
parts.info: Where most digestion and absorption of nutrients happen.

parts.label: Kidneys
parts.info: Filter the blood to make urine and balance water and salts.
